extraction_notes: The supplied seven-page PDF contains no transfer-characteristics, output-characteristics, or capacitance-versus-VDS figures. Figures are limited to thermal response, gate-charge waveform, switching waveform, and maximum safe operating area, so no usable extraction curves were included.
The tabulated capacitances are typical values at VDS = 25 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz: Ciss = 2100 pF, Coss = 165 pF, Crss = 80 pF.
The datasheet publishes typical Qg = 39.2 nC, Qgs = 5.9 nC, and Qgd = 8.8 nC at VDS = 30 V, VGS = 10 V, ID = 10 A; these have no fields in the strict extraction schema.
The body-diode row specifies VSD maximum 1.2 V at VGS = 0 V, IS = 1 A, TJ = 25 degC.
No document revision is stated; the supplied PDF metadata creation date is 2026-03-19.
omission_reason: No usable transfer, output, or capacitance curves are present in the supplied PDF; only tabulated electrical characteristics and unrelated thermal, gate-charge, switching, and safe-operating-area figures are available.
